outcomes.intended_user_result: An authorized operator can inspect a proposed task, record its application, record an observed outcome, and see the full lineage without automatic execution.
outcomes.current_baseline: Catalyst exports proposal-only task manifests with no durable application or outcome lifecycle.
outcomes.acceptance: Paired Observatory journey, lineage, lifecycle projection, archive restore, and full release gate pass.

excluded_scope: No new Mind tool, automatic execution, external write, model, provider, proxy, compaction, schema, importer, or learning-policy change.
